# cursor_model_access_provider (Resource)

Enables or disables one model-access provider. Catalog ids look like anthropic. Reads and writes return 409 while configuration state is unrestricted or legacy; apply cursor_model_access_configuration first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cursor_model_access_provider" "anthropic" {
  provider_id = "anthropic"
  enabled     = true

  depends_on = [cursor_model_access_configuration.team]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is enabled.
- `provider_id` (String) Catalog provider id, such as anthropic.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Display name returned by the API.
- `id` (String) Provider catalog id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cursor_model_access_provider.anthropic anthropic
```
